lines.text: At a Yellowstone geyser basin, Lena wanted a closer photo
She put one foot over the edge of the boardwalk.
The ground there can be a thin crust over scalding water.
Here's the fix. In thermal areas, always stay on the boardwalks and marked trails.
Lean on your zoom, not your feet.
Her best photo came from the boardwalk.
Save this before your Yellowstone trip.
